item.title: SHAFT 0.76.0
item.description:
Added

  • shaft review: one line per week for the instance's unprompted offers (messages sent during judged self-origin cycles): replied by quote, other link (reply, thumb or comment), no reply, open (#14).

Fixed

  • Quote-replies typed in a conversation now count as replies to the message they quote; they were never read, so they showed as no_link (#14).
  • Tailscale is found in ~/Applications too, after /Applications: api, migrate (local and remote) and the app's phone setup (#39).

Full release notes
